purpose.summary: This program performs a database base-transfer (Transferência de Base) for a specific indexed file (EFW310.CAD / WCF31000.cpy), copying records from a source company/branch to a destination company/branch. It validates the source and destination files, converts records by substituting company and branch codes, and logs progress and errors throughout.
purpose.domain: banking or financial ERP (company/branch record management, likely Brazilian business software)
